dogecoin.text: @simon_j_henry @elonmusk @heydave7 @dogecoin_devs Very fair points. Clearly any crypto trying to fill the role of exchange of value will need to be blazing fast and very secure. If Doge can't be adapted to do those things, it will fail. Either way, progress will be made Doge will be part of that story.

@simon_j_henry @elonmusk @heydave7 @dogecoin_devs Sometimes it's easier to take the one with great marketing but inferior tech and improve the tech.

I'm no fan of Doge, but it can't be denied that the meme drove exposure to a wider audience that others wouldn't have reached. Not saying it will succeed, but there is logic to it.
